svg.title: From listings to a selection gap
svg.desc: Four listings of Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones arrive from a reference catalog and two marketplaces. Three black listings link to one canonical product (auto-match scores 0.90 and 0.97); the silver reference listing becomes its own product because a color conflict forces no match despite 0.78 title similarity. Marketplace A carries the black product; the silver one is reported missing: reason VARIANT_NOT_CARRIED, confidence 0.90, priority 80, P1.
